description: Builds the one extra caveat the UI renders above a partial report's results, naming exactly which stages did not succeed and, for a failed run, the stored error message. Signature and severity rule are as declared in 05_reporting.module_spec.json's public_interface.
signature: def partial_run_caveat(missing_stages: Sequence[str], run: RunRecord) -> Caveat
docstring:
Build the caveat describing why a report is partial.

Args:
    missing_stages: The stages that did not succeed, in pipeline order. Never empty -- callers only invoke this when is_partial_run(...) is True.
    run: The RunRecord for status and error_message.

Returns:
    A Caveat with key='partial_run', a title naming the run's status, a body listing missing_stages plus run.error_message when present, and severity: 'error' when run.status == 'failed', 'warning' when run.status in {'running', 'cancelled'} -- a run still in progress or deliberately stopped by the user is not itself a defect, unlike an outright failure.
postconditions: The returned Caveat.body names every entry of missing_stages, in the order given
severity == 'error' if and only if run.status == 'failed'
When run.error_message is not None, it appears verbatim in the body; when it is None, no error-message line is added (never rendered as the literal string 'None')

edge_cases.expected_behavior: raises ValueError -- calling this for a non-partial run is a caller bug; load_run_report only calls it when is_partial_run(stages) is True
severity='warning'; body states the run is still in progress and names 'analysis' as not yet complete; no error-message line

edge_cases.input: run.status == 'failed', missing_stages=['enrichment', 'analysis'], run.error_message='enrichment: ValueError: bad row'
edge_cases.expected_behavior: severity='error'; body names both missing stages and includes the error_message verbatim
severity='warning'; body states the run was cancelled and lists missing_stages; no error-message line

edge_cases.input: run.status == 'succeeded' but missing_stages is non-empty (should not occur given ADR-016, but not structurally prevented if a caller passes mismatched arguments)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: not specially guarded against; falls through to the 'warning' branch since 'succeeded' is not 'failed' -- callers must not construct this combination

unit_tests.name: test_running_severity_and_wording
unit_tests.description: A running, partial run produces severity='warning' and a body naming the missing stage without an error-message line.
unit_tests.expected: severity == 'warning'; body contains 'analysis'; 'None' not in body

unit_tests.name: test_failed_severity_and_error_message
unit_tests.description: A failed run's caveat has severity='error' and includes the stored error_message verbatim.
unit_tests.expected: severity == 'error'; body contains 'enrichment: ValueError: bad row'

unit_tests.name: test_cancelled_severity_is_warning
unit_tests.description: A cancelled run's caveat has severity='warning', not 'error'.

unit_tests.name: test_empty_missing_stages_raises
unit_tests.description: Calling with an empty missing_stages list raises ValueError.
